title: Polar Bear 2026
claim: The Polar Bear 2026 creepypasta began on Russian TikTok in early 2023 and was revived at the end of August 2026 by TikToker @bigbakdiskk28.
excerpt: AI image of a polar bear on its front paws captioned (Russian) 'This is a November meme from 2026, you won't understand yet'; English spread Sept 2023; revival late Aug 2026 with the 'Remember November 2026 is coming' video.
